correctness.rationale: Convolution identifies both endpoint operator norms with the normalized L1 norm of the four-term Dirichlet kernel. Taylor expansions of residue-specific exact formulas give the stated nonzero second-order coefficients. Direct computation is used only as a replay check.

value.rationale: The quantity is a classical endpoint Fourier-projection/Lebesgue constant, not an arbitrary slice. The exact formula exposes a structural finite-sampling effect: alignment of the cyclic mesh with the quarter-period zeros changes the sign of the leading N^{-2} error. This gives a reusable finite-grid benchmark and distinguishes the four-term kernel from the adjacent three-frequency case rather than merely incrementing a parameter table.
